messages.subject: Foxley completion bundle — courier collecting at 2pm
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah — the completion bundle for the Foxley settlement is ready at reception and the courier is collecting at 2pm for delivery to the client. Can you initial the covering letter before it goes? (Apologies — I think I sent the earlier version of this to the wrong Sarah in Corporate. Please ignore any duplicate.)

Donna
